nodes.label: Sequence state
nodes.description: initial binds prompt as current at t=0; next commits appended IDs at t+1; final reads the terminal sequence including prompt. No KV cache; phases are alternatives in time.

nodes.label: Prepare inputs
nodes.description: Preserve the entire integer sequence; derive integer positions 0..S-1 and the additive causal mask [B,1,S,S] for this full no-cache call.

nodes.label: Next token
nodes.description: Unpadded single-sequence illustration: -1 is the last valid sequence position; the vocabulary index is already a token ID.
